def transform(grid):
    # For each row with a foreground object, recolor its trailing background
    # segment (after the last non-background cell) to color 1.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        occupied = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        if occupied:
            for c in range(occupied[-1] + 1, len(row)):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
